brainlife.name: neuro/seg-eval-metric-agg

original.desc: Equal-weight per-image segmentation metrics: mean, population standard deviation, and valid-value count for raw and target-informed neighbor-corrected results.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Summarising segmentation performance of a team or batch.

**Not for:** Per-image inspection; use neuro/seg-eval-metrics.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 1 (aggregated, non-revealing) by default.

**Apps:** output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.seg-eval-metric-agg.json
